name: Onboarding Tour: skeleton fallback renders honestly, Regenerate replaces the tour
description: Covers AC-10 (skeleton badge honest, never empty/error), AC-14 (5 cards + TOC + header with files-indexed + last-refreshed), AC-15 (Regenerate replaces the displayed tour). The hermetic seed never writes a repo_index_state row for acme/payments-api, so container.repoIntel.getIndexState synthesises a degraded 'no_data' state (repo-intel/service.ts getIndexState) — the onboarding service branches straight to the deterministic skeleton (server/src/modules/onboarding/service.ts branch()) and never calls the LLM, matching this harness's 'no LLM, no API keys' convention (e2e/README.md). Regenerate re-runs the same no-model branch and replaces the cached+displayed tour with a fresh generated_at.
